summary: iter-84 independent verification of the missing PORTFOLIO STOP layer + read-only Risk Layers registry. Backend: 13/13 pytest green (7 pre-existing test_iter84_risk_layers.py + 6 new HTTP tests in test_iter84_risk_layers_http.py). Verified /api/risk/layers returns exactly 12 layers with all expected keys and valid statuses; 403 for cross-user account; 404 for bogus ObjectId; admin bypass works. Portfolio-stop end-to-end trip flow via HTTP + DB verified: synthetic account (balance 10k, equity 8.5k, fresh heartbeat) + active bot_config → sweep_portfolio_stop returns 1, config becomes active:false with tripped_kind='portfolio', critical ops_alert with dedup_key 'portfolio_stop:<acc>' created, PortfolioStopTripped trade_event written, 2nd sweep returns 0. Stale-heartbeat fail-safe confirmed (2020 hb + 50% dd → degraded, no trip). All synthetic docs cleaned up (0 leftovers). Backend logs show NO exceptions from _portfolio_stop_loop; /api/metrics returns 200 (with X-Metrics-Token). Frontend: admin login → Risk Commander page mounts RiskLayersCard at top with all 12 layer testids present, summary badge = '9/12 ARMED · 3 DEGRADED', account label badge = 'STOIC' (auto-selected most-recent heartbeating account). Chat panel + input still render below the card. Bot Health page loads fine (regression clean).

minor.issue: Doc drift: /app/memory/test_credentials.md claims '/api/metrics accepts X-Metrics-Token header OR an admin session cookie'. Current metrics_routes.py:_authorized ONLY accepts the token (returns 403 'bad metrics token' for admin cookie). Not a bug per se — this is stricter than doc; update the doc or add the admin fallback.

issues: Review-request stated route is /risk but the actual React route is /commander (App.js:114). The sidebar link labelled 'Risk Commander' navigates to /commander and works correctly, so no user-visible issue. Just a minor doc/spec mismatch.

action_items: OPTIONAL: reconcile /app/memory/test_credentials.md wording OR extend metrics_routes._authorized to accept an admin session cookie — currently token-only.
OPTIONAL: update review-request text to say route is '/commander' not '/risk' (or add a '/risk' alias) — sidebar link routes correctly today.
critical_code_review_comments: risk_layers.py:66-134 — check_portfolio_stop correctly gates on fresh heartbeat + non-null equity BEFORE evaluating drawdown. Fail-safe order is correct (stale/no-data → degraded, never trip). Threshold override read from bot_configs.portfolio_stop_pct is picked from the FIRST config in cfgs list — if multiple configs exist with different overrides, ordering is undefined. Minor: consider min() of all overrides for safety.

risk_layers.py:96-105 — trip loop iterates cfgs but only checks c.get('active') at the start, so an already-inactive config is silently skipped. This is the correct 'no re-trip' behaviour, verified by test_trip_disable_and_no_retrip.

risk_layers.py:189-195 — _isolated wrapper is exactly the isolation guarantee promised in the docstring: a raising layer degrades to status='error' without aborting the sweep. Verified by test_isolated_layer_error_cannot_break_others.

risk_layers.py:198-324 — evaluate_layers is O(12) per call, ~2 mongo hits per invocation (bot_configs.find_one + trades.count_documents + realised_pnl_since×3). Fine for a UI card polled every 30s. No indexes to add — the queries already hit bot_configs {user_id,account_id} and trades {user_id,status}.

routes/risk_layers_routes.py:16-30 — ownership check compares str(account.user_id) == user['id']. This is correct as long as user['id'] is always a string (it is — see auth.get_current_user). Admin bypass via user.get('role') == 'admin' is correct and tested.

routes/risk_layers_routes.py:26-29 — auto-select uses sort=[('last_heartbeat', -1)] on ISO-string heartbeats. Lexicographic sort of ISO-8601 strings is chronologically correct as long as heartbeats are always UTC (they are, per _now().isoformat()). No mongo index on accounts.last_heartbeat — for a large tenant this could get slow, but n_accounts_per_user ≪ 100 in practice.

RiskLayersCard.jsx:16-27 — polls every 30s; on any error setHidden(true) hides the card forever until re-mount. Silent failure is acceptable for a status widget, but consider logging the failure once for support telemetry.

RiskLayersCard.jsx:41-44 — summary text is derived client-side from layers array, NOT from server d.tripped / d.degraded counters. This means the card's summary and the server counters could disagree during a partial re-render, but in practice they match. Acceptable.
